name: agent-mesh
description: Makes a Shofer node a participant in the NATS agent mesh: delivers inbound async notifications/events into the running agent, emits telemetry, and exposes mesh_publish/mesh_subscribe tools so the agent can emit and subscribe to events itself. Pure-JS (no native deps). See ./DESIGN.md and saas.md §5.5.
author: Shofer

subscriptions.description: Static subjects to auto-subscribe on start; incoming messages are injected into the agent (like mesh_subscribe, but from config).

deliverMode.description: How an inbound mesh message reaches the agent (ctx.agent.notify mode).

telemetry.description: Publish this node's task events to NATS under telemetrySubjectPrefix.<taskId> (kept out of any orchestrator history).
